answers.justification: The registry reports HbA1c endpoint denominators of 132, 134, and 133 (399 total) in the treatment-regimen analysis, compared with 423 randomized participants who received at least one dose. This indicates outcome data for the great majority, though not all, participants; the modest missing fraction appears compatible with 'nearly all' availability.
unknowns: The registry denominator is for participants with evaluable data in the MMRM and does not separately state that every participant had a week-24 measurement.
